issue.title: Session Vault: versioned, encrypted, off-machine storage and cross-machine resume for agent conversations
acceptanceCriteria: `pan vault setup <git-url>` enables the vault and shows the recovery phrase once; with no backend every verb says the vault is off.
A conversation on machine A is browsable read-only on machine B within one sync interval, marked with its owner.
"Continue here" on B launches a native Claude Code session from the saved `VIEW`; ownership transfers exactly once under concurrent adoption; A's native file is untouched.
A byte scan of the backend finds no plaintext transcript line, title, cwd or project name; no conversation content transits any Overdeck-operated service.
All `pan vault` verbs work in an empty `HOME` with no dashboard and no `pan install`.
No transcript is deleted without the operator confirming a reviewed pending-deletion batch; evict then restore round-trips byte-for-byte.
Excluded projects and conversations never enter the vault.

blocker.title: The git backend has no cross-process lock; concurrent settlements corrupt the LOG, and eviction still verifies the file
